name: Hotaru
source:
The protagonist of this story. She is transported to another world called Eden after touching a mysterious playing card in her grandfather's room. In order to return to her original world, she travels through the various countries that exist in Eden.

[Adapted from [url=https://game.mba-international.jp/monomagiacantabile/]official website[/url]]
